question: Will the talks reopen Hormuz this month, yes or no?
hook_lines: QATAR GAS TANKER HIT IN GULF

lines.text: Qatar says its gas tanker Al Mayeda was struck by unidentified objects in the Gulf.
Today, Britain's UKMTO said another ship was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
The owner says no crew were hurt and there was no environmental damage.
It says the ship is in a safe condition, operational.
Qatar's foreign ministry called it a dangerous act that threatens global energy supplies.
lines.note: Qatar MFA on X, via Al Jazeera

lines.text: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and the Gulf Cooperation Council have condemned the attack.
No one has claimed it. Iran says ships need its permission to cross the strait.
Al Jazeera, citing shipping data, says more than one hundred and twenty ships have been hit since the war began.
lines.note: Al Jazeera, IMO and UKMTO data

scene.label: commercial ships hit
scene.detail: since the war began in Feb

lines.text: October was the worst month, with at least twenty nine ships hit, against twenty in March.
Qatar is a mediator. Its delegation arrived in Tehran on Friday to revive US and Iran talks.
Day two hundred and forty eight tomorrow. Will the talks reopen Hormuz this month, yes or no?
